articles.title: Robinhood slides 4% despite earnings beat as crypto revenue cools
articles.snippet: The brokerage reported $100 million revenue from crypto trading, a 38% decline in a year, offset by stronger options, equities and prediction markets activity.

articles.title: The 100x obsession: Fundamentals grow in importance as crypto matures
articles.snippet: Crypto’s fundamentals have never been stronger, yet degens keep chasing hot new narratives. Behavioral finance may explain why get-rich-quick stories continue to beat substance.

articles.title: The Dumbest-Looking AI Prompt Just Beat Months of Careful Game-Design Prompt Engineering
articles.snippet: The dev told Claude Opus 5 to be "utterly perfect" and left the rest up to the model—the results turned out to be utterly perfect, for an AI model.
